001package com.streamConverter.controller;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.EnhancedCommandFactory;
004import com.streamConverter.factory.FactoryConfiguration;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.slf4j.Logger;
009import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
010
011/**
012 * Factory for creating and managing stream controllers with CommandFactory integration.
013 *
014 * <p>This factory provides centralized controller creation and management, supporting:
015 *
016 * <ul>
017 *   <li>Controller creation based on data types and processing requirements
018 *   <li>CommandFactory integration for unified command and controller creation
019 *   <li>Type-safe OutputType enum for eliminating hardcoded string literals
020 *   <li>Controller registry for reuse and management
021 *   <li>Automatic controller selection based on input/output types
022 *   <li>Configuration validation and optimization
023 *   <li>Detailed logging control through CommandFactory integration
024 * </ul>
025 *
026 * <p>The factory pattern enhances the Controller architecture by providing a single entry point for
027 * external systems to obtain appropriate controllers while leveraging the existing CommandFactory
028 * infrastructure for consistent command creation and logging.
029 *
030 * <p>Usage examples:
031 *
032 * <pre>
033 * // Get controller by data types (string-based)
034 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getController("CSV", "JSON_PROPERTY");
035 *
036 * // Get controller with OutputType enum (type-safe)
037 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getController("CSV", OutputType.JSON_PROPERTY);
038 *
039 * // Get controller with CommandFactory integration and OutputType enum
040 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.createWithCommandFactory("CSV", OutputType.JSON_FORMATTED, true);
041 *
042 * // Get controller with specific configuration
043 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getCsvController()
044 *     .forColumnExtraction("name");
045 *
046 * // Register custom controller
047 * ControllerFactory.registerController("CUSTOM_CSV", "CUSTOM_OUTPUT", customController);
048 * </pre>
049 *
050 * @author StreamConverter Team
051 * @version 1.0
052 * @since 1.0
053 */
054public class ControllerFactory {
055
056  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ControllerFactory.class);
057
058  /** Registry of controllers by type combination */
059  private static final Map<String, IStreamController> controllerRegistry = new HashMap<>();
060
061  /** Registry of controller builders by input type */
062  private static final Map<String, ControllerBuilder> builderRegistry = new HashMap<>();
063
064  /** Enhanced command factory for optimized command creation */
065  private static final EnhancedCommandFactory commandFactory =
066      EnhancedCommandFactory.createProductionInstance();
067
068  static {
069    // Initialize default builders with CommandFactory integration
070    builderRegistry.put("CSV", new CsvControllerBuilder());
071    builderRegistry.put("JSON", new JsonControllerBuilder());
072
073    log.info(
074        "Initialized ControllerFactory with enhanced CommandFactory integration for optimized performance");
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Gets a controller for the specified input and output data types using OutputType enum.
079   *
080   * <p>This method provides type-safe controller creation by using the OutputType enum instead of
081   * string literals.
082   *
083   * @param inputType the expected input data type (e.g., "CSV", "JSON", "XML")
084   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
085   * @return appropriate controller, or null if none can be created
086   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if input parameters are invalid
087   */
088  public static IStreamController getController(String inputType, OutputType outputType) {
089    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
090    return getController(inputType, outputType.getValue());
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Gets a controller for the specified input and output data types.
095   *
096   * <p>This method attempts to find an appropriate controller from the registry or create a new one
097   * using the available builders.
098   *
099   * @param inputType the expected input data type (e.g., "CSV", "JSON", "XML")
100   * @param outputType the expected output data type (e.g., "CSV_COLUMN", "JSON_PROPERTY")
101   * @return appropriate controller, or null if none can be created
102   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if input parameters are invalid
103   */
104  public static IStreamController getController(String inputType, String outputType) {
105    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
106    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
107
108    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
109
110    // Check registry first
111    IStreamController cachedController = controllerRegistry.get(key);
112    if (cachedController != null) {
113      log.debug("Found cached controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
114      return cachedController;
115    }
116
117    // Try to create using builders
118    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
119    if (builder != null) {
120      IStreamController controller = builder.createForOutputType(outputType);
121      if (controller != null) {
122        log.info("Created controller for {} → {} using builder", inputType, outputType);
123        // Cache for future use
124        controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
125        return controller;
126      }
127    }
128
129    log.warn("No controller available for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
130    return null;
131  }
132
133  /**
134   * Gets a CSV controller builder for advanced configuration.
135   *
136   * @return CSV controller builder
137   */
138  public static CsvControllerBuilder getCsvController() {
139    return new CsvControllerBuilder();
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Gets a JSON controller builder for advanced configuration.
144   *
145   * @return JSON controller builder
146   */
147  public static JsonControllerBuilder getJsonController() {
148    return new JsonControllerBuilder();
149  }

151  /**
152   * Creates a controller using CommandFactory-style configuration with OutputType enum.
153   *
154   * <p>This method provides type-safe controller creation while leveraging the existing
155   * CommandFactory infrastructure for unified command and controller creation.
156   *
157   * @param inputType the expected input data type
158   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
159   * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging for created commands
160   * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if none can be created
161   */
162  public static IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
163      String inputType, OutputType outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
164    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
165    return createWithCommandFactory(inputType, outputType.getValue(), enableDetailedLogging);
166  }
167
168  /**
169   * Creates a controller using CommandFactory-style configuration.
170   *
171   * <p>This method leverages the existing CommandFactory infrastructure to provide a unified
172   * approach to both controller and command creation.
173   *
174   * @param inputType the expected input data type
175   * @param outputType the expected output data type
176   * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging for created commands
177   * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if none can be created
178   */
179  public static IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
180      String inputType, String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
181    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
182    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
183
184    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
185
186    // Check registry first
187    IStreamController cachedController = controllerRegistry.get(key);
188    if (cachedController != null) {
189      log.debug(
190          "Found cached CommandFactory-integrated controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
191      return cachedController;
192    }
193
194    // Create using enhanced builders with CommandFactory integration
195    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
196    if (builder instanceof CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) {
197      CommandFactoryAwareBuilder enhancedBuilder = (CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) builder;
198      IStreamController controller =
199          enhancedBuilder.createWithCommandFactory(outputType, enableDetailedLogging);
200      if (controller != null) {
201        log.info(
202            "Created CommandFactory-integrated controller for {} → {} with detailed logging: {}",
203            inputType,
204            outputType,
205            enableDetailedLogging);
206        controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
207        return controller;
208      }
209    }
210
211    // Fallback to standard creation
212    return getController(inputType, outputType);
213  }
214
215  /**
216   * Registers a custom controller for specific input/output type combination.
217   *
218   * @param inputType the input data type
219   * @param outputType the output data type
220   * @param controller the controller to register
221   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if parameters are invalid
222   */
223  public static void registerController(
224      String inputType, String outputType, IStreamController controller) {
225    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
226    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
227    Objects.requireNonNull(controller, "Controller cannot be null");
228
229    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
230    controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
231
232    log.info(
233        "Registered custom controller for {} → {}: {}",
234        inputType,
235        outputType,
236        controller.getClass().getSimpleName());
237  }
238
239  /**
240   * Registers a custom controller builder for a specific input type.
241   *
242   * @param inputType the input data type
243   * @param builder the controller builder to register
244   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if parameters are invalid
245   */
246  public static void registerBuilder(String inputType, ControllerBuilder builder) {
247    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
248    Objects.requireNonNull(builder, "Builder cannot be null");
249
250    builderRegistry.put(inputType, builder);
251
252    log.info(
253        "Registered custom builder for input type {}: {}",
254        inputType,
255        builder.getClass().getSimpleName());
256  }
257
258  /**
259   * Creates a controller with optimized CommandFactory integration. This method addresses Issue
260   * #124 by reducing redundancy and improving integration.
261   *
262   * @param inputType the expected input data type
263   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
264   * @param config factory configuration for optimization
265   * @return optimized controller with enhanced integration
266   */
267  public static IStreamController createOptimized(
268      String inputType, OutputType outputType, FactoryConfiguration config) {
269    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
270    Objects.requireNonNull(config, "Factory configuration cannot be null");
271
272    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType.getValue());
273
274    // Check cache first
275    IStreamController cached = controllerRegistry.get(key);
276    if (cached != null && config.isCachingEnabled()) {
277      log.debug("Retrieved cached optimized controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
278      return cached;
279    }
280
281    // Create using optimized command factory
282    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
283    if (builder instanceof CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) {
284      CommandFactoryAwareBuilder enhancedBuilder = (CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) builder;
285
286      // Use enhanced command factory for better performance
287      IStreamController controller =
288          enhancedBuilder.createWithCommandFactory(
289              outputType.getValue(), config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled());
290
291      if (controller != null) {
292        log.info(
293            "Created optimized controller for {} → {} with enhanced CommandFactory integration",
294            inputType,
295            outputType);
296
297        if (config.isCachingEnabled()) {
298          controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
299        }
300        return controller;
301      }
302    }
303
304    // Fallback to standard creation
305    return getController(inputType, outputType);
306  }
307
308  /**
309   * Gets the enhanced command factory instance used by this controller factory. This provides
310   * access to the optimized command creation infrastructure.
311   *
312   * @return enhanced command factory instance
313   */
314  public static EnhancedCommandFactory getCommandFactory() {
315    return commandFactory;
316  }

318  /**
319   * Gets all registered controller types.
320   *
321   * @return array of registered input → output type combinations
322   */
323  public static String[] getRegisteredTypes() {
324    return controllerRegistry.keySet().toArray(new String[0]);
325  }
326
327  /**
328   * Clears all registered controllers and builders.
329   *
330   * <p>This method is primarily for testing purposes.
331   */
332  public static void clearRegistry() {
333    controllerRegistry.clear();
334    builderRegistry.clear();
335    log.info("Controller registry cleared");
336  }
337
338  /** Creates a registry key from input and output types. */
339  private static String createRegistryKey(String inputType, String outputType) {
340    return inputType + " → " + outputType;
341  }
342
343  /** Interface for controller builders. */
344  public interface ControllerBuilder {
345    /**
346     * Creates a controller for the specified output type.
347     *
348     * @param outputType the desired output type
349     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
350     */
351    IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType);
352  }
353
354  /** Interface for builders that can integrate with CommandFactory. */
355  public interface CommandFactoryAwareBuilder extends ControllerBuilder {
356    /**
357     * Creates a controller with CommandFactory integration.
358     *
359     * @param outputType the desired output type
360     * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging
361     * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if not supported
362     */
363    IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging);
364  }
365
366  /** Builder for CSV controllers. */
367  public static class CsvControllerBuilder implements CommandFactoryAwareBuilder {
368
369    @Override
370    public IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType) {
371      OutputType type = OutputType.fromString(outputType);
372      if (type != null) {
373        return createForOutputType(type);
374      }
375
376      // Fallback for unknown string types
377      log.warn("Unknown output type for CSV controller: {}", outputType);
378      return null;
379    }
380
381    /**
382     * Creates a controller for the specified OutputType enum.
383     *
384     * @param outputType the desired output type as enum
385     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
386     */
387    public IStreamController createForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
388      switch (outputType) {
389        case CSV_COLUMN:
390          return CsvProcessingController.forColumnExtraction("default");
391        case PROCESSED_DATA:
392          return CsvProcessingController.forComplexProcessing("default", "default-processor");
393        case CSV:
394          return CsvProcessingController.forPassThrough();
395        default:
396          log.warn("Unsupported output type for CSV controller: {}", outputType);
397          return null;
398      }
399    }
400
401    /**
402     * Creates a controller for column extraction.
403     *
404     * @param columnSelector column name or index to extract
405     * @return configured controller
406     */
407    public CsvProcessingController forColumnExtraction(String columnSelector) {
408      return CsvProcessingController.forColumnExtraction(columnSelector);
409    }
410
411    /**
412     * Creates a controller for complex processing.
413     *
414     * @param columnSelector column name or index
415     * @param processorId processor ID
416     * @return configured controller
417     */
418    public CsvProcessingController forComplexProcessing(String columnSelector, String processorId) {
419      return CsvProcessingController.forComplexProcessing(columnSelector, processorId);
420    }
421
422    /**
423     * Creates a controller for pass-through processing.
424     *
425     * @return configured controller
426     */
427    public CsvProcessingController forPassThrough() {
428      return CsvProcessingController.forPassThrough();
429    }
430
431    @Override
432    public IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
433        String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
434      // Create controller using standard method, as AbstractStreamController
435      // already integrates with CommandFactory for command creation
436      IStreamController controller = createForOutputType(outputType);
437
438      if (controller != null) {
439        log.debug(
440            "Created CSV controller with CommandFactory integration for output type: {}, detailed logging: {}",
441            outputType,
442            enableDetailedLogging);
443      }
444
445      return controller;
446    }
447  }
448
449  /** Builder for JSON controllers. */
450  public static class JsonControllerBuilder implements CommandFactoryAwareBuilder {
451
452    @Override
453    public IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType) {
454      OutputType type = OutputType.fromString(outputType);
455      if (type != null) {
456        return createForOutputType(type);
457      }
458
459      // Fallback for unknown string types
460      log.warn("Unknown output type for JSON controller: {}", outputType);
461      return null;
462    }
463
464    /**
465     * Creates a controller for the specified OutputType enum.
466     *
467     * @param outputType the desired output type as enum
468     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
469     */
470    public IStreamController createForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
471      switch (outputType) {
472        case JSON_PROPERTY:
473          return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction("default", false);
474        case VALIDATED_JSON_PROPERTY:
475          return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction("default", true);
476        case JSON_FORMATTED:
477          return JsonProcessingController.forFormatting();
478        case TRANSFORMED_DATA:
479          return JsonProcessingController.forTransformation("default", "default-processor");
480        default:
481          log.warn("Unsupported output type for JSON controller: {}", outputType);
482          return null;
483      }
484    }
485
486    /**
487     * Creates a controller for property extraction.
488     *
489     * @param propertyPath JSON property path
490     * @param enableValidation whether to enable validation
491     * @return configured controller
492     */
493    public JsonProcessingController forPropertyExtraction(
494        String propertyPath, boolean enableValidation) {
495      return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction(propertyPath, enableValidation);
496    }
497
498    /**
499     * Creates a controller for JSON formatting.
500     *
501     * @return configured controller
502     */
503    public JsonProcessingController forFormatting() {
504      return JsonProcessingController.forFormatting();
505    }
506
507    /**
508     * Creates a controller for multi-stage transformation.
509     *
510     * @param propertyPath JSON property path
511     * @param processingStages processing stage IDs
512     * @return configured controller
513     */
514    public JsonProcessingController forTransformation(
515        String propertyPath, String... processingStages) {
516      return JsonProcessingController.forTransformation(propertyPath, processingStages);
517    }
518
519    @Override
520    public IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
521        String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
522      // Create controller using standard method, as AbstractStreamController
523      // already integrates with CommandFactory for command creation
524      IStreamController controller = createForOutputType(outputType);
525
526      if (controller != null) {
527        log.debug(
528            "Created JSON controller with CommandFactory integration for output type: {}, detailed logging: {}",
529            outputType,
530            enableDetailedLogging);
531      }
532
533      return controller;
534    }
535  }
536}
